settings.Query: SELECT ContentTypeID, ContentTypeName FROM BDOMetadata_ContentType WHERE ContentTypeSiteID = {%CurrentSite.SiteID|(identity)GlobalAdministrator|(hash)571ca26443a0eac7c877015eee6f4fadfa94e2c303c70458edae269d9c60ab9a%} AND ContentTypeCultureCode = '{%EditedObject.DocumentCulture|(identity)GlobalAdministrator|(hash)21a5f677e12be6d195003b54734a0cd784177fd8a3db8182e67e2c4f86d3e3c3%}' ORDER BY ContentTypeName

SELECT NodeID, MetadataTitle FROM View_CMS_Tree_Joined WITH(NOEXPAND) INNER JOIN BDO_MicrositeMasterPage ON MicrositeMasterPageID = DocumentForeignKeyValue WHERE ClassName = 'BDO.MicrositeMasterPage' AND NodeSiteID = {%CurrentSite.SiteID|(identity)GlobalAdministrator|(hash)571ca26443a0eac7c877015eee6f4fadfa94e2c303c70458edae269d9c60ab9a%} AND DocumentCulture = '{%EditedObject.DocumentCulture|(identity)GlobalAdministrator|(hash)21a5f677e12be6d195003b54734a0cd784177fd8a3db8182e67e2c4f86d3e3c3%}' ORDER BY MetadataTitle

SELECT NodeID, MetadataTitle FROM View_CMS_Tree_Joined WITH(NOEXPAND) INNER JOIN BDO_MicrositePage ON MicrositePageID = DocumentForeignKeyValue WHERE ClassName = 'BDO.MicrositePage' AND NodeSiteID = {%CurrentSite.SiteID|(identity)GlobalAdministrator|(hash)571ca26443a0eac7c877015eee6f4fadfa94e2c303c70458edae269d9c60ab9a%} AND DocumentCulture = '{%EditedObject.DocumentCulture|(identity)GlobalAdministrator|(hash)21a5f677e12be6d195003b54734a0cd784177fd8a3db8182e67e2c4f86d3e3c3%}' ORDER BY MetadataTitle

SELECT RSSCategoryID, RSSCategoryName, ODR FROM ( SELECT RSSCategoryID, RSSCategoryName, '1' as ODR FROM BDOMetadata_RSSCategory WHERE RSSCategorySiteID = {%CurrentSite.SiteID|(identity)GlobalAdministrator|(hash)571ca26443a0eac7c877015eee6f4fadfa94e2c303c70458edae269d9c60ab9a%} AND RSSCategoryCultureCode = '{%EditedObject.DocumentCulture|(identity)GlobalAdministrator|(hash)21a5f677e12be6d195003b54734a0cd784177fd8a3db8182e67e2c4f86d3e3c3%}' UNION SELECT '', ' ', '0') results ORDER BY ODR, RSSCategoryName

SELECT NodeGUID, LastName + ', ' + FirstName AS Name FROM View_CMS_Tree_Joined WITH(NOEXPAND) INNER JOIN BDO_ExternalPerson ON ExternalPersonID = DocumentForeignKeyValue WHERE ClassName = 'BDO.ExternalPerson' AND NodeSiteID = {% CurrentSite.SiteID |(identity)GlobalAdministrator|(hash)032381a356dad4b18e7cebbf68257b166086e975982d8a90aa1fa5ae44e81cee%} AND DocumentCulture = '{% EditedObject.DocumentCulture |(identity)GlobalAdministrator|(hash)1d02bf45129d9f5bf376a5af2d208b7c02e9d638dd6362909755a5a51198a486%}' ORDER BY LastName
